title: An Act to Require Antisemitism to Be Considered as Motivation When Determining a Violation of a Criminal or Civil Law

summary.text: This bill defines "antisemitism" as the nonlegally binding working definition of "antisemitism" adopted by the International Holocaust Remembrance Alliance Plenary in Bucharest, Romania on May 26, 2016. The bill also amends the Maine Human Rights Act to require that, when determining whether a violation of the Maine Human Rights Act or any criminal or civil law has occurred, an assessment of whether antisemitism was a motive, if relevant, for that violation must be made.
